documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30 September 2026 And Others

analysis.summary: MSTC Limited reported its highest ever Q2 and H1 financial results since listing, driven by revenue growth from operations of over 25% year-on-year in H1 FY27. Standalone PBT and PAT both grew by nearly 42% in H1, supported by higher scrap prices and increased iron ore auction volumes. Joint venture MMRPL posted a positive profit in H1 after ten consecutive years of negative numbers. Additionally, the company received in-principle approval from the RBI to operate a Trade Receivable Discounting System (TReDS) platform. MSTC Limited reported its operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, achieving its highest ever Q2 and H1 PBT and PAT since its listing in March 2019.

guidance.claim: MSTC maintains a general aspiration to achieve double-digit growth.
guidance.quote: Look, I am basically a very conservative kind of person. So I would always say that double-digit growth aspiration is what we always have.

guidance.claim: Management targets annual growth rates between 10% and 20%.
guidance.quote: So between 10% to 20%. So that is something that we would always aspire to...

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain double-digit growth in its e-commerce business over the long term.
guidance.quote: So, whether that translates into what was the growth over the corresponding period last year or it would be more or less, the average would be a double-digit growth, which we would be trying to maintain.

demand_outlook.claim: Iron ore auction volumes through MSTC platforms increased significantly during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Similarly, iron ore volumes have increased significantly.

demand_outlook.claim: MSTC platform facilitated the sale of nearly 4 lakh metric tons of chromite and 1.54 million metric tons of iron ore/coal in Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: Apart from nearly 4 lakh metric tons of chromite and 1.54 million metric tons of Iron ore/Coal has also been sold through MSTC platform during this quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the positive trend in the Mahindra joint venture to continue, driving a healthy financial outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: And we expect this trend to strengthen and continue, driving towards a healthy financial outlook for this company.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC obtained in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to establish a TReDS platform.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to inform you that the in-principle approval has been received from the Reserve Bank of India the day before yesterday, of course subject to fulfilling certain conditions and audits.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC is expanding its B2B travel portal by adding corporate clients.
capex_expansion.quote: So apart from the B2B travel portal, for which we are adding corporate clients now and in the process of steady expansion and stabilization.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC is developing a TReDS platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.
capex_expansion.quote: MSTC is developing a TReDS platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is developing a TReDS platform for trade receivables discounting, which is at an advanced stage.
capex_expansion.quote: Developing a trade receivables discounting system, a treads platform has also been taken up as one of the areas showing commercial viability.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC is exploring the establishment of its own coal and mineral exchanges.
capex_expansion.quote: Then you might have learnt about the government’s intention to set up coal and mineral exchanges. So, MSTC is also exploring various possibilities and the ways and methodologies for establishing its own exchanges.

margins_costs.claim: MSTC achieved a peak EBITDA margin of 71.75% during the period.
margins_costs.quote: So before I run down the performance of MSTC as reported by our Chairman and Managing Director, it is the highest ever Q2 and H1 performance since listing of the company in March 2019, and the EBITDA percentage is quite healthy, peaking at 71.75% and basically it has grown, and the growth of revenue from operation, that is 25% of growth on half-yearly basis, as compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone H1 EBITDA grew by nearly Rs. 53.00 crores year-on-year compared to H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: H1 EBITDA increased by nearly Rs. 53.00 crores year-on-year over the same for H1 of FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Total overhead expenses grew by 12.78% in H1 while total revenue grew by 31.25%.
margins_costs.quote: And the total overhead, total expenses stands at INR79.14 crores as compared to INR70.17 crores as an increase of only 12.78%, whereas revenue has grown by 31.25%.

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to keep overheads under control while scaling operations.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are trying to have our overheads in control.

orders_capacity.claim: Gross merchandise value transacted across MSTC portals reached INR 545.80 billion in H1, excluding trading.
orders_capacity.quote: During the H1, the total gross merchandise value that has passed through our portal is INR545.80 billion, and basically it is excluding the trading business this we have, MSTC has finally exited as promised earlier also that it will go to the very risk-free zone.

orders_capacity.claim: MSTC conducted liquor license auctions for Karnataka, generating approximately INR 125 crores for the state.
orders_capacity.quote: So during the quarter, liquor license auctions were held for the Government of Karnataka, resulting in revenue of approximately INR125 crores for the state.

orders_capacity.claim: Land parcel auctions for Telangana generated INR 2,863 crores on MSTC's platform.
orders_capacity.quote: INR2,863 crores was realized for the State of Telangana through successful land parcel auction.

orders_capacity.claim: An oil rig auction conducted on behalf of MSTC realized $5.8 million.
orders_capacity.quote: An oil rig was auctioned on behalf of MSTC realizing $5.8 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has entered into an agreement with the Tamil Nadu Forest Department for the sale of approximately 100 tons of Red sandalwood.
orders_capacity.quote: We had done this exercise about 4-5 years back where we sold some Red sandalwood in the past but again this time also we have entered into an agreement and this transaction will be taking place shortly for sale of about 100 tons of Red sandalwood that is available in the state but this will be through an international competitive bidding.

capital_allocation.claim: Marketing business contribution fell to zero as MSTC fully exited trading activities.
capital_allocation.quote: And which, on the first time the marketing contribution will be zero.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's dividend policy is guided by Government of India directives, specifically the DIPAM guidelines.
capital_allocation.quote: Minimum that is 4% of the net worth or 30% of the PAT, whichever is higher. It is the minimum dividend that a government company has to declare. So, that is guided by that principle.

risks_headwinds.claim: Future operationalization of dedicated coal exchanges may cause trading volumes to migrate away from MSTC's auction platform.
risks_headwinds.quote: So naturally, if there is an exchange, and at some point of time, maybe 3 or 4 or 5 years down the line, the entire trading volume would then be regulated by way of regulation, be done from the exchange.

risks_headwinds.claim: MSTC's new TReDS platform will need to share market volume with four existing operational platforms.
risks_headwinds.quote: So naturally, the business will obviously have to be shared with these other platforms also.

risks_headwinds.claim: The scrap business is cyclical, which can impact revenue growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: But scrap has always been a cyclical thing. The steel sector as such is very cyclical. So, the rates keep going up and down.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces competition from other entities planning to launch coal exchanges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, actually, there are other entities also who are planning to launch their own coal exchanges. So, there will be multiple exchanges in the Gazette notification itself.

management_commitments.claim: Operations on the TReDS platform are expected to stabilize and generate revenue over the next two fiscals.
management_commitments.quote: So subsequent to this, operations on the platform could start on receipt of final authorization, and we are hopeful that this will be a healthy addition to our revenue stream when the platform stabilizes, which should happen over the next 2 fiscals.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach a decision on setting up a coal exchange within 3 to 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to -- we expect that we will come to some kind of a firm conclusion in, let us say, 3 to 4 months, and then we will be able to share as to what is the way forward that we have visualized.

management_commitments.claim: The B2C segment of the MSTC travel portal is expected to launch in 3 to 6 months.
management_commitments.quote: It is likely to take another 3 to 6 months for the portal -- for the B2C part of the portal to come out in the form that we would like it to be.

management_commitments.claim: MSTC has completed the planned process of exiting the legacy Trading business.
management_commitments.quote: MSTC has now completed the planned process of exiting the legacy Trading business.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to operationalize the TReDS platform within FY27, subject to regulatory approvals.
management_commitments.quote: So, our internal target is hopefully FY27, within FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
